# Blame, placement and diagnostics reference

A failing block gets two answers besides its machine verdict: who made the mistake (`policy/blame`) and where one change stops it recurring (`policy/placement`). Both are rule files that read named evidence and never compute it. This page lists every name, generated from the code.

## Evidence names

Every name is computed once by one provider, from what the run, the estate map, the value check and any confirm run stored. A name whose value is unknown is left out, so a condition on it never holds. 46 names ship.

| Cost class | Means |
|---|---|
| `static` | read from the stored run and the estate map; no agent call |
| `judge` | a stored answer of a calibrated judge; replayed, never called by blame |
| `run` | an agent run, made only by `diagnostic/liability-confirm` within its budget, and read once stored |

| Name | Cost | Values | Computed from |
|---|---|---|---|
| `source` | static | user, agent_derived, prompt, tool_output, skill_file, workspace_file | the oracle's provenance tag for the expected value, else where the agent's value appears: the user turn, a file it read, an earlier tool output |
| `change` | static | verbatim, case_only, unit_converted, reformatted, altered | the as-given rung when it ran, else the agent value against its source text |
| `contract` | static | tool, prompt, none, downstream, instruction, skill, error_seen | the contract rung's record, else the tool schema (an enum or a pattern), a stated format, an error the agent read; for a rule verdict, the home of the rule it enforces |
| `contract_broken` | static | boolean | the contract rung's record, else the value against the tool schema or the stated format; a failing verdict that enforces a stated rule breaks it |
| `outcome` | static | accepted_as_gold, failed, resolved_differently | the value-check rungs: the outcome a rung stated, else what it settled (the judge rung settles a different referent) |
| `next_action` | static | asked_user, retried_canonical, gave_up, wrong_fact, continued, looped, recovered | the calls after the failing step (a retry of the same tool, a loop of the same input), else the stored reply reading, else the reply text |
| `declared_format` | static | a form, none | the failing check's own assertion |
| `downstream_need` | static | declared, none | a consumer the block or the project declares |
| `verdict_check` | static | a check name | the failing verdict |
| `verdict_kind` | static | machine, judge | the failing verdict |
| `first_violation` | static | a verdict id | the earliest gating verdict of the block whose outcome is fail (not inconclusive, not not_applicable), by the place of its act in the trace, then check order |
| `rule_atom` | static | atom ids, none | the spec's estate atoms for the failing check, or the block's links with relation verifies |
| `rule_home` | static | core, skill_body, skill_reference, skill_script, helper, guard, tool_schema, instruction, none | the atom's kind and provenance file, or the link's home |
| `rule_skill` | static | a skill name | the provenance path of the atom, or the link |
| `rule_act` | static | load_skill, read_reference, ordered, stage, gate, step, recovery, tool_contract, provenance, integrity | the atom's evidence type (skill_loaded, tool_called, ordered, stage_reached, custom) and kind, or the link's act |
| `act_signature` | static | an act class with its detail | rule_act with the ordered pair or the stage it names |
| `rule_situational` | static | boolean | the atom's situation: a rule stated for one situation of its skill (a pointer's situation is where it fires, already a layout); for a rule no file states, the block's own situation |
| `rule_mechanical` | static | boolean | the failing verdict is a machine verdict |
| `rule_needed_by` | static | number | the skills whose plan rows name the rule's atom, the routed skill, the rule's own skill, and the core prompt when a core atom cites it (a core rule's own home is not counted) |
| `routed_skills` | static | skill names | expect.skills and the route atoms the failing check names |
| `skill_loaded` | static | boolean | the trace's skills list, or a Read of the skill's SKILL.md, for the skill the check is about |
| `skill_covers` | static | covered, not_covered, unknown | the block's plan row for the skill (route_positive: covered, route_near_miss: not_covered); with no such row, a stored reference agent's load count against the bar; else unknown |
| `rule_skill_routed` | static | boolean | derived: rule_skill is one of routed_skills |
| `rule_in_context` | static | boolean | derived: always for a core or instruction rule; skill_loaded for a rule in a skill body; ref_read full for a rule in a reference |
| `ref_exists` | static | boolean | the reference atom's fields.exists |
| `ref_forced` | static | boolean | a reference or gate atom points to the file from a skill body or the core prompt, in this block's situation (a pointer with a situation forces only there) |
| `ref_depth` | static | number | the map edges: 1 when a main file names the reference, 2 or more when only another reference does |
| `ref_read` | static | none, partial, full | Read calls with their offset and limit, head, tail and sed -n commands, and the runtime's references list |
| `guard_caught` | static | boolean | the guard decision log: an enforcing guard denied the act, then allowed it later (the agent complied) |
| `tool_failed` | static | boolean | the error, the reported exit code or the recorded execution of the call the check is about, or a rung that found the tool did not resolve the value |
| `tool_silent` | static | boolean | exit 0 or no error, with output that lacks what the tool's own usage text promises |
| `tool_output_wrong` | static | boolean | a value the agent reported that came from a tool output (not from the user or a file), and that differs from gold |
| `env_error` | static | network, sandbox, package, timeout, none | a classifier over stderr, the output of failed commands and tool errors; the first class that matches, in the order timeout, network, package, sandbox |
| `protected_changed` | static | boolean | a path of the block's protected list changed or deleted in the net workspace diff |
| `tests_fail_reverted` | static | boolean | the stored sandbox re-execution with the agent's test edits reverted (no agent call) |
| `changed_inputs_fail` | static | boolean | the recompute rung: passes on the seed, fails on changed inputs |
| `claim_contradicted` | static | boolean | claims in the reply against the run: tests said to pass while the last test command failed; a file said saved that the diff and the artifacts lack; done while an artifact check failed |
| `stricter_rule_obeyed` | static | boolean | no call of the tool; the reply asks for a part a stated rule demands and the tool does not need; no record that the tool refuses the given value |
| `task_impossible` | static | boolean | the block field task_impossible |
| `task_flagged` | judge | boolean | a stored judged reading of the reply: the agent stopped and said the task or its tests conflict |
| `recurrence_homes` | static | number | the stored diagnoses of the campaign or the store with the same blame item and act, counted by home |
| `recurrence_class_homes` | static | number | the stored diagnoses with the same blame item and any act, counted by home |
| `reference_pass` | run | number | reference-agent runs of diagnostic/liability-confirm, passes out of confirm_runs |
| `reference_loads` | run | number | reference-agent runs that loaded the routed skill, out of confirm_runs |
| `forced_load_pass` | run | number | runs with the skill forced into context that pass, out of confirm_runs |
| `hint_pass` | run | number | runs with the rule repeated as a hint that pass, out of confirm_runs |
